class.name: TextLocalizationCatalog
class.brief_description: A catalog of localized texts with context, plural forms and plural rules.

method.name: add_translation
method.description: Adds all messages of [param translation] to the column of its locale, with their context and plural forms, and takes over its [member Translation.plural_rules_override]. Existing texts of the same keys are replaced. [b]Note:[/b] [OptimizedTranslation] does not store its keys, so it can't be converted; convert the source [Translation] or CSV instead.

method.name: get_plural_form
method.description: Returns the index of the plural form to use for the number [param n] in [param locale]. The rule is the one set with [method set_plural_rule], otherwise the default rule of the locale ([method TranslationServer.get_plural_rules]), otherwise the English rule, like in [Translation].

method.name: get_plural_key
method.description: Returns the plural key of [param key] (the [code]?plural[/code] column of a CSV file, the untranslated plural text), or an empty [String].

method.name: get_plural_rule
method.description: Returns the plural rule set for [param locale], or an empty [String] if the locale uses its default rule.

method.name: get_plural_text
method.description: Returns the plural form of [param key] in [param locale] for the number [param n] (see [method get_plural_form]). Without plural forms, returns the text of the key.

method.name: get_plural_texts
method.description: Returns all plural forms of [param key] in [param locale]. Without plural forms, returns the text as the only element (or an empty array if there is no text).

method.name: get_text
method.description: Returns the text of [param key] with [param context] in [param locale] (the first plural form for plural keys), or an empty [String]. The locale is not resolved: [code]"de_DE"[/code] does not fall back to [code]"de"[/code] here (that is the job of the localization server).

method.name: set_plural_key
method.description: Sets the plural key of [param key] (see [method get_plural_key]). Adds the key if needed.

method.name: set_plural_rule
method.description: Sets the plural rule of [param locale] in gettext form, for example [code]"nplurals=2; plural=(n != 1);"[/code]. An empty [param rule] uses the default rule of the locale.

method.name: set_plural_texts
method.description: Sets the plural forms of [param key] in [param locale]. The first form is also the text returned by [method get_text]. Adds the key and the locale if needed.

method.name: set_text
method.description: Sets the text of [param key] with [param context] in [param locale]. Adds the key and the locale if needed. An empty [param text] marks the key as missing in that locale.

method.name: to_po
method.description: Returns the catalog in the gettext format: a template (POT) with empty translations if [param locale] is empty, otherwise a PO file of [param locale] with its texts, its plural rule as [code]Plural-Forms[/code] header and [code]Language[/code] header. Contexts become [code]msgctxt[/code], plural keys [code]msgid_plural[/code] with [code]msgstr[N][/code] per form, translator notes [code]#.[/code] comments ([code]#. max_length: 12[/code] for other note columns than [code]notes[/code]). Godot's PO loader reads the PO files as [Translation]. The inspector of a text catalog has a "Save POT..." button. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var file = FileAccess.open("res://localization/ui.pot", FileAccess.WRITE) file.store_string(catalog.to_po()) [/gdscript] [csharp] using var file = FileAccess.Open("res://localization/ui.pot", FileAccess.ModeFlags.Write); file.StoreString(catalog.ToPo()); [/csharp] [/codeblocks]

method.name: to_translations
method.description: Returns one [Translation] per locale with all texts, contexts, plural forms and plural rules, for example to add them to the [TranslationServer]. Loads all locales.
